en.name: Tutorial
en.description: Learn the game in a full battle.
en.tutorial.deploy.intro: This is the deployment stage. Your army is stacked on the left of your zone, grouped by type. Spread it across the zone before the battle starts — the layout you pick shapes how the fight begins.
en.tutorial.deploy.selectInfantry: Start with your line infantry. {input.selectUnits} over a block of them to draw a selection box.
en.tutorial.deploy.positionInfantry: Move them up to form the front line. {input.moveUnit} a selected unit to reposition it inside the zone.
en.tutorial.deploy.openFormationInfantry: Open the formations menu — line infantry can switch between line and column.
en.tutorial.deploy.pickColumnInfantry: Pick Column. Narrower frontage, deeper file — moves faster but fires fewer muskets.
en.tutorial.deploy.selectCavalry: Now grab your dragoons. {input.selectUnits} over them.
en.tutorial.deploy.positionCavalry: Place them behind your infantry line — kept in reserve they can charge through gaps or plug a break. {input.moveUnit} to reposition.
en.tutorial.deploy.positionArtillery: Push the guns to the very front of your line so they have a clean shot downrange. Artillery reaches the farthest, but keep the infantry close behind to screen it. {input.moveUnit} to reposition.
en.tutorial.deploy.selectSkirmishers: Last, pick up your skirmishers. {input.selectUnits} over them.
en.tutorial.deploy.positionSkirmishers: Tuck them near trees or broken ground. Skirmishers use cover to harass enemies from a distance, and they fold in melee — so keep them supported. {input.moveUnit} to reposition.
en.tutorial.deploy.deselectBeforeNext: Clear your current selection first — {input.deselect} before picking up the next unit type.
en.tutorial.deploy.confirm: When the army looks good, hit Submit orders to begin the battle.
en.tutorial.move.intro: Push toward the neutral flags {icon.targetFlag} in the center. Each unit type has a different order.
en.tutorial.move.clickOrderTypeInfantry: Open the order menu to pick FAA {icon.fireAdvance}.
en.tutorial.move.chooseOrderInfantry: Pick FAA {icon.fireAdvance} — fires while advancing if enemies appear in the path.
en.tutorial.move.clickOrderTypeCavalry: Open the order menu to switch to Walk {icon.walk}.
en.tutorial.move.chooseOrderCavalry: Pick Walk {icon.walk} — saves stamina for a charge later.
en.tutorial.move.clickOrderTypeArtillery: Open the order menu to switch to Run {icon.run}.
en.tutorial.move.chooseOrderArtillery: Pick Run {icon.run} — limbers up: faster, no stamina cost, but delayed shooting after stopping.
en.tutorial.move.orderArtillery: Keep line of sight {icon.lineOfSight} clean and don't push too far. {input.moveUnit} to draw the path.
en.tutorial.move.selectSkirmisherA: Pick up the highlighted skirmisher — {input.selectUnits} on it.
en.tutorial.move.clickOrderTypeSkirmishers: Open the order menu to switch to Run {icon.run}.
en.tutorial.move.chooseOrderSkirmishers: Pick Run {icon.run} — take woods and villages fast, but don't sprint, they tire.
en.tutorial.move.orderSkirmisherA: Push this skirmisher into the highlighted cover {icon.forest} {icon.building} near the neutral objective. {input.moveUnit} to draw the path.
en.tutorial.move.selectSkirmisherB: Now grab the other skirmisher — {input.selectUnits} on it.
en.tutorial.move.orderSkirmisherB: Send this one into different cover. Skirmishers work best when they're spread out.
en.tutorial.move.deselectBeforeNext: {input.deselect} before picking the next unit type.
en.tutorial.move.selectIdleInfo: Shortcut: Select Idle jumps straight to the next unit waiting for orders — handy once you have a big army.
en.tutorial.move.removeOrdersInfo: Changed your mind? Remove Orders clears the orders on the selected units so you can redraw them.
en.tutorial.move.submit: All set. Submit orders to end the turn. Keep submitting until you spot the enemy — your units will follow the orders you set.
en.tutorial.advance.noEnemy: No enemies in sight — keep advancing. Give your units orders and submit to end the turn.
en.tutorial.enemyContact.selectInfantry: Line infantry first. {input.selectGroup} on one to grab the whole group.
en.tutorial.enemyContact.openFormationInfan: Open the formations menu — time to deploy in line.
en.tutorial.enemyContact.pickLineInfantry: Pick Line. Wider frontage, maximum firepower facing the enemy.
en.tutorial.firefight.switchToLine: You're in musket range with your flanks covered — switch your infantry to line. Wider frontage means double the muskets firing, with extra resistance to incoming fire. Keep an eye on those flanks: a line that gets charged from the side breaks fast.
en.tutorial.stamina.message: Running burns stamina. Tired units hit softer and rout faster. Walk into position and save the sprint for when it actually matters.
en.tutorial.shoot.message: Skirmishers and artillery shoot on their own once an enemy walks into range. Skirmishers hit hard at distance but fold in melee, so keep them behind your line. Artillery reaches the furthest. Don't let cavalry get close to it.
en.tutorial.charge.message: Hold Shift when you order a dragoon and it'll charge instead of walking in. A good charge can break an infantry line, but it wears your horses out fast. Pick the moment.
en.tutorial.objectives.message: Each flag you hold gives you Victory Points every turn and brings in manpower for replacements. Whoever ends the battle with more VP wins. That's the whole game.
en.tutorial.formation.message: A supported line is hard to break. Don't leave skirmishers or artillery on their own. One cavalry charge into an isolated unit is enough to end it. Screen with line infantry and anchor with artillery.
en.tutorial.morale.message: Units rout when their organization collapses. Losses, a flank attack, or plain exhaustion can all do it. A routing unit won't fight. Pull tired units back to recover and send fresh ones up.
en.tutorial.finalPush.message: Clock's almost out. Whoever has more VP when it hits zero wins. Pick the flag that decides it and throw everything at that one. Don't try to hold everywhere.
en.tutorial.situational.skirmisherVsArtille: Enemy battery in your skirmisher's reach. Pour fire into the gun crew — light infantry shred unprotected artillery before it can answer.
Pick FAA {icon.fireAdvance} so the skirmisher closes and fires on the way in.
en.tutorial.situational.skirmisherVsCavalry: Cavalry near your skirmisher — they'll get ridden down in the open. Break contact now, before the charge lands.
Pick Fallback {icon.fallback} and pull the skirmisher away from the horsemen. Aim for ~128 px back, opposite the threat.
en.tutorial.situational.skirmisherVsInfantr: Enemy infantry on top of your skirmisher. Skirmishers fold in melee — pull back before bayonets reach.
Pick Fallback {icon.fallback} and disengage. Get out of musket-rush range.
en.tutorial.situational.infantryVsCavalryFr: Cavalry charging your front. Hold the line — line infantry facing a frontal charge can stand and fire. Don't form square or you'll lose your firepower.
en.tutorial.situational.infantryVsCavalryFl: Cavalry coming at your flank or rear. A line gets ridden over from the side — form square so every face has muskets out.
Open the formation menu and pick Square. All-around defense, no exposed flank.
en.tutorial.situational.artilleryRotateToFi: Your cannon has a clean shot but it's still moving. Stop the march and turn the gun — autofire will engage next turn.
Pick Rotate {icon.rotate} and aim at the enemy. The gun stops, faces the target, and gets to fire.
